takes.prior_whisper_text: Every machine humanity has ever landed on another world, sits inside a bubble of light less than two light hours across, while the nearest star beyond our sun is 4.24 light years away. Inside that small neighborhood we have set cameras down on a scorching twin where lead melts on the ground and on a frozen red desert where nuclear rovers drive for years through the dust. This is one continuous journey outward from the ground moving under your feet, past the worlds our landers have touched, through the comet cloud at the edge of the sun's reach and out to the giant stars that forge the atoms in your hands. It begins right where you are sitting.
